title: Adding and Subtracting Decimals
seo_title: Grade 5 Adding and Subtracting Decimals Worksheets (TEKS 5.3K, STAAR)
standard_text: 5.3K add and subtract positive rational numbers fluently
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 decimal worksheets for Texas TEKS 5.3K: line up decimal points, hundredths grids, add with regrouping, subtract with zeros and money word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Write zeros so both numbers have the same places: 5 − 2.37 = 5.00 − 2.37 = 2.63.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Line up the decimal points so each place lines up: tenths with tenths, hundredths with hundredths.
  • Write zeros so both numbers have the same number of places: 5 = 5.00.
  • Add or subtract as with whole numbers, regrouping as needed, and bring the decimal point straight down.

Examples

Example

3.6 + 2.45

3.60 + 2.45

Answer: 6.05

Example

5 − 2.37

5.00 − 2.37

Answer: 2.63

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Lining up the last digits: 3.6 + 2.45 = 2.81Line up the decimal points.
Not writing zeros: 5 − 2.37Write 5 as 5.00 first.
Dropping the decimal pointBring it straight down into the answer.

faq.a: Add and subtract positive rational numbers, including decimals, fluently.

faq.q: Why line up the decimal points?
faq.a: So that digits with the same place value are added together.
Yes. 4.5 = 4.50 = 4.500. Zeros at the end of a decimal do not change its value.
Estimate by rounding to whole numbers, or add the difference back.

items.q: To add 3.6 + 2.45, you write 3.6 with two decimal places. Which number is equal to 3.6?
items.e: A zero at the end of a decimal does not change its value: 3.6 = 3 ones and 6 tenths = 3.60. 3.06 is wrong: it moves the 6 to the hundredths place.

items.q: To find 12 + 4.75, you can write 12 with a decimal point. Which number is equal to 12?
items.e: A whole number has its decimal point after the ones digit, so 12 = 12.00. Then the 2 ones sit over the 4 ones.

items.q: Nevaeh lined up the last digits and got 2.81. What is the correct sum?
items.e: Line up the decimal points, not the last digits: 3.60 + 2.45. Hundredths: 0 + 5 = 5. Tenths: 6 + 4 = 10, write 0 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Answer: 6.05. Estimate: 4 + 2 = 6, so 2.81 is far too small.

items.q: Valeria lined up the last digits and got 2.53. What is the correct sum?
items.e: 15 is a whole number, so its point is after the 5: 15 = 15.00 (not 1.5). Line up the points: 15.00 + 2.38. Hundredths: 0 + 8 = 8. Tenths: 0 + 3 = 3. Ones: 5 + 2 = 7. Tens: bring down 1. Answer: 17.38.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 7.6 as 7.60. Hundredths: 0 + 9 = 9. Tenths: 6 + 3 = 9. Ones: 7 + 6 = 13, write 13. Answer: 13.99. Check: 13.99 − 6.39 = 7.6.

items.q: What is 7.27 + 3.1?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 3.1 as 3.10. Hundredths: 7 + 0 = 7. Tenths: 2 + 1 = 3. Ones: 7 + 3 = 10, write 10. Answer: 10.37. Check: 10.37 − 3.1 = 7.27.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 7.1 as 7.10. Hundredths: 5 + 0 = 5. Tenths: 3 + 1 = 4. Ones: 3 + 7 = 10, write 10. Answer: 10.45. Check: 10.45 − 7.1 = 3.35.

items.q: What is 2.79 + 0.1?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 0.1 as 0.10. Hundredths: 9 + 0 = 9. Tenths: 7 + 1 = 8. Ones: 2 + 0 = 2. Answer: 2.89. Check: 2.89 − 0.1 = 2.79.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 0.5 as 0.50. Hundredths: 7 + 0 = 7. Tenths: 4 + 5 = 9. Ones: 3 + 0 = 3. Answer: 3.97. Check: 3.97 − 0.5 = 3.47.

items.q: What is 9.1 + 0.16?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 9.1 as 9.10. Hundredths: 0 + 6 = 6. Tenths: 1 + 1 = 2. Ones: 9 + 0 = 9. Answer: 9.26. Check: 9.26 − 0.16 = 9.1.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 8.4 as 8.40. Hundredths: 0 + 3 = 3. Tenths: 4 + 2 = 6. Ones: 8 + 0 = 8. Answer: 8.63. Check: 8.63 − 0.23 = 8.4.

items.q: What is 8.72 + 9?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 9 as 9.00. Hundredths: 2 + 0 = 2. Tenths: 7 + 0 = 7. Ones: 8 + 9 = 17, write 17. Answer: 17.72. Check: 17.72 − 9 = 8.72.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 3 as 3.00. Hundredths: 0 + 1 = 1. Tenths: 0 + 2 = 2. Ones: 3 + 1 = 4. Answer: 4.21. Check: 4.21 − 1.21 = 3.
Line up the decimal points. Write 91.5 as 91.50. Hundredths: 0 + 1 = 1. Tenths: 5 + 0 = 5. Ones: 1 + 5 = 6. Tens: bring down 9. Answer: 96.51. Check: 96.51 − 5.01 = 91.5.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 42.5 as 42.50. Hundredths: 0 + 9 = 9. Tenths: 5 + 0 = 5. Ones: 2 + 8 = 10, write 0 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 4 + 1 = 5. Answer: 50.59. Check: 50.59 − 8.09 = 42.5.
Line up the decimal points. Write 8.8 as 8.80. Hundredths: 4 + 0 = 4. Tenths: 0 + 8 = 8. Ones: 8 + 8 = 16, write 6 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 4 + 1 = 5. Answer: 56.84. Check: 56.84 − 8.8 = 48.04.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 2.6 as 2.60. Hundredths: 2 + 0 = 2. Tenths: 1 + 6 = 7. Ones: 5 + 2 = 7. Tens: bring down 8. Answer: 87.72. Check: 87.72 − 2.6 = 85.12.

items.q: What is 64 + 1.14?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 64 as 64.00. Hundredths: 0 + 4 = 4. Tenths: 0 + 1 = 1. Ones: 4 + 1 = 5. Tens: bring down 6. Answer: 65.14. Check: 65.14 − 1.14 = 64.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 46.8 as 46.80. Hundredths: 0 + 4 = 4. Tenths: 8 + 1 = 9. Ones: 6 + 2 = 8. Tens: 4 + 2 = 6. Answer: 68.94. Check: 68.94 − 22.14 = 46.8.
Line up the decimal points. Write 63.1 as 63.10. Hundredths: 0 + 6 = 6. Tenths: 1 + 3 = 4. Ones: 3 + 0 = 3. Tens: 6 + 2 = 8. Answer: 83.46. Check: 83.46 − 20.36 = 63.1.

sets.title: Add and subtract with hundredths grids

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.2 and the yellow part is 0.56. What is 0.2 + 0.56?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.2 = 20 hundredths and 0.56 = 56 hundredths. Together: 20 + 56 = 76 hundredths = 0.76. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.2 is 20 hundredths, not 2.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.6 and the yellow part is 0.17. What is 0.17 + 0.6?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.17 = 17 hundredths and 0.6 = 60 hundredths. Together: 17 + 60 = 77 hundredths = 0.77. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.6 is 60 hundredths, not 6.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.5 and the yellow part is 0.38. What is 0.5 + 0.38?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.5 = 50 hundredths and 0.38 = 38 hundredths. Together: 50 + 38 = 88 hundredths = 0.88. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.5 is 50 hundredths, not 5.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.3 and the yellow part is 0.09. What is 0.3 + 0.09?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.3 = 30 hundredths and 0.09 = 9 hundredths. Together: 30 + 9 = 39 hundredths = 0.39. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.3 is 30 hundredths, not 3.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.7 and the yellow part is 0.06. What is 0.06 + 0.7?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.06 = 6 hundredths and 0.7 = 70 hundredths. Together: 6 + 70 = 76 hundredths = 0.76. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.7 is 70 hundredths, not 7.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.5 and the yellow part is 0.25. What is 0.25 + 0.5?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.25 = 25 hundredths and 0.5 = 50 hundredths. Together: 25 + 50 = 75 hundredths = 0.75. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.5 is 50 hundredths, not 5.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.3 and the yellow part is 0.43. What is 0.43 + 0.3?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.43 = 43 hundredths and 0.3 = 30 hundredths. Together: 43 + 30 = 73 hundredths = 0.73. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.3 is 30 hundredths, not 3.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.8 and the yellow part is 0.12. What is 0.12 + 0.8?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.12 = 12 hundredths and 0.8 = 80 hundredths. Together: 12 + 80 = 92 hundredths = 0.92. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.8 is 80 hundredths, not 8.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.7 and the yellow part is 0.24. What is 0.7 + 0.24?
items.e: Each small square is 0.01 and each column is 0.1. 0.7 = 70 hundredths and 0.24 = 24 hundredths. Together: 70 + 24 = 94 hundredths = 0.94. Do not add the digits as if they were the same place: 0.7 is 70 hundredths, not 7.

items.q: Each grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.8 and the yellow part is 0.45. What is 0.8 + 0.45?
items.e: 80 hundredths + 45 hundredths = 80 + 45 = 125 hundredths. 100 hundredths fill one whole grid, so the sum is 1 whole and 25 hundredths = 1.25. The sum is more than 1, so 0.125 is too small.

items.q: Each grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.7 and the yellow part is 0.65. What is 0.65 + 0.7?
items.e: 65 hundredths + 70 hundredths = 65 + 70 = 135 hundredths. 100 hundredths fill one whole grid, so the sum is 1 whole and 35 hundredths = 1.35. The sum is more than 1, so 0.135 is too small.

items.q: Each grid is 1 whole. The green part is 0.9 and the yellow part is 0.36. What is 0.9 + 0.36?
items.e: 90 hundredths + 36 hundredths = 90 + 36 = 126 hundredths. 100 hundredths fill one whole grid, so the sum is 1 whole and 26 hundredths = 1.26. The sum is more than 1, so 0.126 is too small.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. 0.75 is shaded. The squares with an X are taken away. What is 0.75 − 0.3?
items.e: 0.75 is 75 hundredths. Taking away 0.3 (30 hundredths) leaves 75 − 30 = 45 hundredths: the squares without an X. 0.75 − 0.3 = 0.45.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. 0.9 is shaded. The squares with an X are taken away. What is 0.9 − 0.25?
items.e: 0.9 is 90 hundredths. Taking away 0.25 (25 hundredths) leaves 90 − 25 = 65 hundredths: the squares without an X. 0.9 − 0.25 = 0.65.

items.q: The grid is 1 whole. 0.68 is shaded. The squares with an X are taken away. What is 0.68 − 0.4?
items.e: 0.68 is 68 hundredths. Taking away 0.4 (40 hundredths) leaves 68 − 40 = 28 hundredths: the squares without an X. 0.68 − 0.4 = 0.28.

items.q: Each grid is 1 whole. 1.2 is shaded. The squares with an X are taken away. What is 1.2 − 0.45?
items.e: 1.2 is 120 hundredths. Taking away 0.45 (45 hundredths) leaves 120 − 45 = 75 hundredths: the squares without an X. 1.2 − 0.45 = 0.75.

items.q: To add 0.6 + 0.27, you can write 0.6 in hundredths. 0.6 is the same as how many hundredths?
items.e: 0.6 is 6 tenths, and each tenth is 10 hundredths, so 0.6 = 0.60 = 60 hundredths. Then 0.6 + 0.27 = 60 + 27 = 87 hundredths = 0.87.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 0.35 + ☐ = 1
items.e: 1 whole is 100 hundredths and 0.35 is 35 hundredths. 100 − 35 = 65 hundredths = 0.65. Check: 0.35 + 0.65 = 1. (0.75 is wrong: 0.35 + 0.75 = 1.1.)

items.q: What is 0.6 + 0.4?
items.e: 6 tenths + 4 tenths = 10 tenths. 10 tenths make 1 whole, so 0.6 + 0.4 = 1. Writing 0.10 forgets to regroup: 0.10 is only 1 tenth.

items.q: What is 0.9 + 0.3?
items.e: 9 tenths + 3 tenths = 12 tenths. 10 tenths make 1 whole, so 12 tenths = 1 whole and 2 tenths = 1.2. 0.12 is wrong: it puts 12 in the tenths place without regrouping.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 8 + 6 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 7 + 5 + 1 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 4 + 2 + 1 = 7. Answer: 7.34. Check: 7.34 − 2.56 = 4.78.

items.q: What is 4.9 + 9.2?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Tenths: 9 + 2 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 4 + 9 + 1 = 14, write 14. Answer: 14.1. Check: 14.1 − 9.2 = 4.9.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 25.9 as 25.90. Hundredths: 0 + 6 = 6. Tenths: 9 + 8 = 17, write 7 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 5 + 5 + 1 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 9 + 1 = 12, write 12. Answer: 121.76. Check: 121.76 − 95.86 = 25.9.

Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 3 + 9 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 6 + 6 + 1 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 7 + 4 + 1 = 12, write 12. Answer: 12.32. Check: 12.32 − 4.69 = 7.63.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 2.7 as 2.70. Hundredths: 2 + 0 = 2. Tenths: 8 + 7 = 15, write 5 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Answer: 6.52. Check: 6.52 − 2.7 = 3.82.
Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 1 + 2 = 3. Tenths: 8 + 8 = 16, write 6 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 5 + 0 + 1 = 6. Answer: 6.63. Check: 6.63 − 0.82 = 5.81.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 13.6 as 13.60. Hundredths: 3 + 0 = 3. Tenths: 6 + 6 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 6 + 3 + 1 = 10, write 0 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 1 + 1 = 2. Answer: 20.23. Check: 20.23 − 13.6 = 6.63.

Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 5 + 6 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 8 + 5 + 1 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 0 + 8 + 1 = 9. Tens: bring down 4. Answer: 49.41. Check: 49.41 − 8.56 = 40.85.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 7 + 1 = 8. Tenths: 4 + 7 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 5 + 5 + 1 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 9 + 8 + 1 = 18, write 18. Answer: 181.18. Check: 181.18 − 85.71 = 95.47.
Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 4 + 9 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 8 + 7 + 1 = 16, write 6 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 3 + 1 + 1 = 5. Answer: 5.63. Check: 5.63 − 1.79 = 3.84.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 5 + 1 = 6. Tenths: 4 + 8 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 3 + 5 + 1 = 9. Tens: bring down 2. Answer: 29.26. Check: 29.26 − 25.81 = 3.45.

Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 7 + 2 = 9. Tenths: 7 + 8 = 15, write 5 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 9 + 7 + 1 = 17, write 7 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 6 + 6 + 1 = 13, write 13. Answer: 137.59. Check: 137.59 − 67.82 = 69.77.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 7 + 6 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 7 + 8 + 1 = 16, write 6 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 7 + 5 + 1 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 4 + 2 + 1 = 7. Answer: 73.63. Check: 73.63 − 25.86 = 47.77.

Line up the decimal points. Write 78.2 as 78.20. Hundredths: 0 + 5 = 5. Tenths: 2 + 8 = 10, write 0 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 8 + 3 + 1 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 7 + 1 = 8. Answer: 82.05. Check: 82.05 − 3.85 = 78.2.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 72.7 as 72.70. Hundredths: 0 + 3 = 3. Tenths: 7 + 6 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 2 + 2 + 1 = 5. Tens: bring down 7. Answer: 75.33. Check: 75.33 − 2.63 = 72.7.

items.q: What is 6.52 + 9.6?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 9.6 as 9.60. Hundredths: 2 + 0 = 2. Tenths: 5 + 6 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 6 + 9 + 1 = 16, write 16. Answer: 16.12. Check: 16.12 − 9.6 = 6.52.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 6.8 as 6.80. Hundredths: 5 + 0 = 5. Tenths: 6 + 8 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 8 + 6 + 1 = 15, write 15. Answer: 15.45. Check: 15.45 − 6.8 = 8.65.
Line up the decimal points. Write 2.5 as 2.50 and 0.8 as 0.80. Hundredths: 0 + 5 + 0 = 5. Tenths: 5 + 7 + 8 = 20, write 0 and regroup 2 ones. Ones: 2 + 1 + 0 + 2 = 5. Answer: 5.05.

Line up the decimal points. Write 3.9 as 3.90. Hundredths: 8 + 0 + 5 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 4 + 9 + 3 + 1 = 17, write 7 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 6 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 1 + 1 = 2. Answer: 22.73.
Line up the decimal points. Write 4.7 as 4.70. Hundredths: 5 + 0 + 8 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 6 + 7 + 0 + 1 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 0 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 7. Answer: 7.43.

items.q: To find 5 − 2.37, how should you write 5 so both numbers have hundredths?
items.e: 5 is 5 ones, and its decimal point is after the 5. Write 5.00: two zeros hold the tenths and hundredths places. Then 5.00 − 2.37 = 2.63.

items.q: Carlos found 8.2 − 3.45 = 4.75. Which addition checks his answer?
items.e: Addition undoes subtraction. Add the answer to the number taken away: 4.75 + 3.45 = 8.20 = 8.2. You get back the starting number, so his answer is right.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 5 as 5.00. Hundredths: 0 − 7 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 one: the ones become 4, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 10. 10 − 7 = 3. Tenths: 9 − 3 = 6. Ones: 4 − 2 = 2. Answer: 2.63. Check: 2.63 + 2.37 = 5.

items.q: What is 8.2 − 3.45?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 8.2 as 8.20. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 1 − 4 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 11 − 4 = 7. Ones: 7 − 3 = 4. Answer: 4.75. Check: 4.75 + 3.45 = 8.2.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 10 as 10.00. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 ten: the tens become 0, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 10. 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 9 − 6 = 3. Ones: 9 − 4 = 5. Answer: 5.35. Check: 5.35 + 4.65 = 10.

Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 3 − 8 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 one: the ones become 5, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 13. 13 − 8 = 5. Tenths: 9 − 4 = 5. Ones: 5 − 2 = 3. Answer: 3.55. Check: 3.55 + 2.48 = 6.03.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 7.4 as 7.40. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 3 − 8 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 13 − 8 = 5. Ones: 6 − 2 = 4. Answer: 4.55. Check: 4.55 + 2.85 = 7.4.

items.q: What is 12 − 7.08?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 12 as 12.00. Hundredths: 0 − 8 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 one: the ones become 1, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 10. 10 − 8 = 2. Tenths: 9 − 0 = 9. Ones: 1 − 7 needs a regroup. 1 ten becomes 10 ones: 11 − 7 = 4. Answer: 4.92. Check: 4.92 + 7.08 = 12.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 7.4 as 7.40. Hundredths: 0 − 8 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 8 = 2. Tenths: 3 − 4 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 13 − 4 = 9. Ones: bring down 6. Answer: 6.92. Check: 6.92 + 0.48 = 7.4.

items.q: What is 37.1 − 6.7?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Tenths: 1 − 7 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 11 − 7 = 4. Ones: 6 − 6 = 0. Tens: bring down 3. Answer: 30.4. Check: 30.4 + 6.7 = 37.1.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 2.1 as 2.10. Hundredths: 0 − 8 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 8 = 2. Tenths: 0 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 10 − 9 = 1. Ones: bring down 1. Answer: 1.12. Check: 1.12 + 0.98 = 2.1.

Line up the decimal points. Write 17.4 as 17.40. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 3 − 0 = 3. Ones: 7 − 4 = 3. Tens: bring down 1. Answer: 13.35. Check: 13.35 + 4.05 = 17.4.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Tenths: 1 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 11 − 9 = 2. Ones: 4 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 ten becomes 10 ones: 14 − 5 = 9. Tens: bring down 8. Answer: 89.2. Check: 89.2 + 5.9 = 95.1.
Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 9 − 7 = 2. Tenths: 3 − 8 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 13 − 8 = 5. Ones: 3 − 3 = 0. Tens: bring down 8. Answer: 80.52. Check: 80.52 + 3.87 = 84.39.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 55 as 55.0. Tenths: 0 − 1 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 10 − 1 = 9. Ones: 4 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 ten becomes 10 ones: 14 − 9 = 5. Tens: bring down 4. Answer: 45.9. Check: 45.9 + 9.1 = 55.

Line up the decimal points. Write 71.2 as 71.20. Hundredths: 0 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 9 = 1. Tenths: 1 − 6 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 11 − 6 = 5. Ones: 0 − 3 needs a regroup. 1 ten becomes 10 ones: 10 − 3 = 7. Tens: bring down 6. Answer: 67.51. Check: 67.51 + 3.69 = 71.2.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 47.3 as 47.30. Hundredths: 0 − 2 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 2 = 8. Tenths: 2 − 0 = 2. Ones: 7 − 1 = 6. Tens: bring down 4. Answer: 46.28. Check: 46.28 + 1.02 = 47.3.
Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 6 − 2 = 4. Tenths: 3 − 8 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 13 − 8 = 5. Ones: 3 − 3 = 0. Tens: 6 − 3 = 3. Answer: 30.54. Check: 30.54 + 33.82 = 64.36.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 65.5 as 65.50. Hundredths: 0 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 9 = 1. Tenths: 4 − 3 = 1. Ones: 5 − 6 needs a regroup. 1 ten becomes 10 ones: 15 − 6 = 9. Tens: bring down 5. Answer: 59.11. Check: 59.11 + 6.39 = 65.5.

items.q: What is 8 − 1.56?
items.e: Line up the decimal points. Write 8 as 8.00. Hundredths: 0 − 6 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 one: the ones become 7, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 10. 10 − 6 = 4. Tenths: 9 − 5 = 4. Ones: 7 − 1 = 6. Answer: 6.44. Check: 6.44 + 1.56 = 8.

items.q: Valeria bought a book for $8.75 and a pen for $1.49. How much did she spend?
items.e: Put the two prices together: add. Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 5 + 9 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 7 + 4 + 1 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 8 + 1 + 1 = 10, write 10. Answer: 10.24. Check: 10.24 − 1.49 = 8.75.

items.q: Isabella paid for a $13.68 lunch with a $20 bill. How much change did she get?
items.e: Change is what is left: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Write 20 as 20.00. Hundredths: 0 − 8 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 ten: the tens become 1, each 0 becomes 9, and the hundredths become 10. 10 − 8 = 2. Tenths: 9 − 6 = 3. Ones: 9 − 3 = 6. Tens: 1 − 1 = 0. Answer: 6.32. Check: 6.32 + 13.68 = 20.

items.q: A ribbon is 2.5 meters long. Mateo cuts off 0.75 meters for a bow. How much ribbon is left?
items.e: Take the part cut off away: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Write 2.5 as 2.50. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 4 − 7 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 14 − 7 = 7. Ones: bring down 1. Answer: 1.75. Check: 1.75 + 0.75 = 2.5.

items.q: In a 100-meter race, Ava ran it in 14.62 seconds and Lucia ran it in 13.9 seconds. How many seconds faster was Lucia?
items.e: The faster runner has the smaller time. Find the difference: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Write 13.9 as 13.90. Hundredths: 2 − 0 = 2. Tenths: 6 − 9 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 16 − 9 = 7. Ones: 3 − 3 = 0. Tens: 1 − 1 = 0. Answer: 0.72. Check: 0.72 + 13.9 = 14.62.

items.q: It rained 2.36 inches on Monday and 1.8 inches on Tuesday. How much did it rain on the two days?
items.e: Put the two days together: add. Line up the decimal points. Write 1.8 as 1.80. Hundredths: 6 + 0 = 6. Tenths: 3 + 8 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 2 + 1 + 1 = 4. Answer: 4.16. Check: 4.16 − 1.8 = 2.36.

items.q: Ximena's puppy weighed 4.6 kilograms. In a month, it gained 0.85 kilograms. How much does the puppy weigh now?
items.e: The puppy got heavier: add. Line up the decimal points. Write 4.6 as 4.60. Hundredths: 0 + 5 = 5. Tenths: 6 + 8 = 14, write 4 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 4 + 0 + 1 = 5. Answer: 5.45. Check: 5.45 − 0.85 = 4.6.

items.q: In the long jump, Jayden jumped 3.8 meters on his first try and 3.45 meters on his second try. How much longer was the first jump?
items.e: How much longer means find the difference: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Write 3.8 as 3.80. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 7 − 4 = 3. Ones: 3 − 3 = 0. Answer: 0.35. Check: 0.35 + 3.45 = 3.8.

items.q: In gymnastics, Ethan scored 9.35 on the beam and 8.9 on the floor. What was his total score?
items.e: Total means add. Line up the decimal points. Write 8.9 as 8.90. Hundredths: 5 + 0 = 5. Tenths: 3 + 9 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 9 + 8 + 1 = 18, write 18. Answer: 18.25. Check: 18.25 − 8.9 = 9.35.

items.q: A bottle holds 1.5 liters of water. Caleb drinks 0.35 liters. How much water is left in the bottle?
items.e: Take away what he drank: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Write 1.5 as 1.50. Hundredths: 0 − 5 needs a regroup. 1 tenth becomes 10 hundredths: 10 − 5 = 5. Tenths: 4 − 3 = 1. Ones: bring down 1. Answer: 1.15. Check: 1.15 + 0.35 = 1.5.

items.q: A family drove 125.6 miles before lunch and 87.45 miles after lunch. How far did they drive in all?
items.e: In all means add. Line up the decimal points. Write 125.6 as 125.60. Tenths: 6 + 4 = 10, write 0 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 5 + 7 + 1 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 8 + 1 = 11, write 1 and regroup 1 hundred. The other places add without regrouping. Answer: 213.05. Check: 213.05 − 87.45 = 125.6.

items.q: A normal body temperature is 98.6°F. Liam has a fever of 101.2°F. How many degrees above normal is his temperature?
items.e: How many degrees above means find the difference: subtract. Line up the decimal points. Tenths: 2 − 6 needs a regroup. 1 one becomes 10 tenths: 12 − 6 = 6. Ones: 0 − 8 needs a regroup, but the next place is 0. Regroup 1 hundred: the hundreds become 0, each 0 becomes 9, and the ones become 10. 10 − 8 = 2. Tens: 9 − 9 = 0. Answer: 2.6. Check: 2.6 + 98.6 = 101.2.

items.q: In a relay race, Mia ran the first lap in 32.48 seconds and Zoe ran the second lap in 29.75 seconds. What was their total time?
items.e: Total time means add the two laps. Line up the decimal points. Hundredths: 8 + 5 = 13, write 3 and regroup 1 tenth. Tenths: 4 + 7 + 1 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 one. Ones: 2 + 9 + 1 = 12, write 2 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Answer: 62.23. Check: 62.23 − 29.75 = 32.48.

items.q: Aaliyah has $25. She buys a puzzle for $8.49 and a kite for $6.75. How much money does she have left?
A swim team relay is 3.2 kilometers in all. The first swimmer swims 1.45 kilometers and the second swims 0.9 kilometers. How far does the third swimmer have to swim?
items.e: Step 1, first two swimmers: 1.45 + 0.9 = 2.35 kilometers. Step 2, the rest: 3.20 − 2.35 = 0.85 kilometers. (1.66 is wrong: it lines up the last digits, 1.45 + 0.9 = 1.54, instead of the decimal points.)

items.q: What number goes in the box? ☐ + 2.45 = 6
items.e: Use subtraction: 6 − 2.45 = 6.00 − 2.45 = 3.55. Check: 3.55 + 2.45 = 6.00 = 6. (4.45 forgets to write the zeros: 6 − 2 = 4, then brings down .45.)

Round each number to the nearest whole number. Which is the best estimate for 6.82 + 3.29?
items.e: 6.82 rounds to 7 and 3.29 rounds to 3. 7 + 3 = 10. The exact answer, 10.11, is close to 10.

items.q: Round each number to the nearest whole number. Which is the best estimate for 12.15 − 4.9?
items.e: 12.15 rounds to 12 and 4.9 rounds to 5. 12 − 5 = 7. The exact answer, 7.25, is close to 7.

items.q: Round each number to the nearest whole number. Which is the best estimate for 8.47 + 5.6?
items.e: 8.47 rounds to 8 and 5.6 rounds to 6. 8 + 6 = 14. The exact answer, 14.07, is close to 14.

items.q: Marcus added 3.6 + 2.45 and got 2.81. Round each number to the nearest whole number to check. What does the estimate show?
items.e: 3.6 rounds to 4 and 2.45 rounds to 2, so the sum should be about 4 + 2 = 6. 2.81 is much smaller than 6, so it is too small. Marcus lined up the last digits. The correct sum is 3.60 + 2.45 = 6.05.
